usage.title: AI assistant
usage.text: How many messages the AI read for your company this month, and on each day. Only counts are kept, never the messages.
usage.limit_text: The limit is the rule "AI readings per month". Past it, your modules go on without AI until the next month.
usage.limit_reached: This month's AI readings are used up. Replies go on with keywords only until the next month.
usage.no_key: The AI is not set up on this server yet (no key), so nothing is read. Ask the platform's administrator.
usage.empty_text: Turn on "AI reads what the keywords miss" in Facebook selling's rules, and readings show here.
